name: Markov
short: Per-user Markov models, chain stats, admin controls, and channel-wide auto-modeling
description: ZanCogs-compatible Markov with chain statistics, opt-out-respecting administrator enrollment, channel-wide auto-modeling for future messages, and data deletion.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-user message-derived Markov models (which can combine messages across guilds), opt-in/opt-out flags, user model settings, per-server manually enabled user IDs, and per-server channel IDs enabled for all non-bot members. Admins can enable learning for all members in specified channels without asking each user to opt in. No message history is imported. Explicit user opt-outs are respected; users can opt out with markov disable and delete existing models with markov reset. Administrator enrollment can send a DM. The cog implements Red's user data deletion.
